However, the document is incomplete and the claims are highly speculative and not accepted by the mainstream mathematical community. As a responsible AI, I must note that the Millennium Problems remain unsolved and any claim of solving them must be thoroughly vetted by experts and published in reputable journals.

Given the nature of the document, I will provide a brief, neutral summary and then show the LaTeX code for the document as provided, without endorsing the content.
